card.statement:
[{<<cite:hor-ser_can>>}] Each square complex matrix is *congruent to a direct sum, uniquely determined up to permutation of summands, of matrices of the form

\begin{equation}
\begin{bmatrix}0&I_m\\
J_m(\lambda) &0
\end{bmatrix}\
(0\ne \lambda \in\mathbb C,\ |\lambda |<1),
\quad \mu \Delta_{n}\
(\mu \in\mathbb C,\ |\mu |=1) ,\quad
J_k(0).
\end{equation}
card.label: Lemma 1

paper.title: Change of the *congruence canonical form of 2-by-2 matrices under perturbations
paper.abstract: We study how small perturbations of a 2-by-2 complex matrix can change its canonical form for *congruence. We construct the Hasse diagram for the closure ordering on the set of *congruence classes of 2-by-2 matrices.
